description: This file contains helper functions for encoding and decoding E1AP (E-UTRAN New Radio Access Network Application Protocol) messages related to CU-UP (Central Unit - User Plane) in a 5G network, including functions for converting request and response structures to ASN.1 representations, validation, and handling bearer context modifications.

methods.name: cu_up_e1_setup_request_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a CU-UP E1 setup request structure to ASN.1 format for transmission.

methods.name: check_e1ap_bearer_context_setup_request_valid
methods.description: Validates an ASN.1 bearer context setup request message.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_drb_to_setup_item
methods.description: Fills a DRB setup item structure with ASN.1 data.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Fills a bearer context setup request structure from ASN.1 message.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_setup_response
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 response message for bearer context setup.

methods.name: fill_e1ap_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Fills a bearer context modification request structure from ASN.1 message.

methods.name: fill_asn1_bearer_context_modification_response
methods.description: Fills ASN.1 response message for bearer context modification.
